svg.title: Transmitter, option A: XIAO nRF52840
svg.desc: Guitar plug P1 into the MCP6002 buffer, then C3 into WM8960 LINPUT1. WM8960 MCLK, BCLK, LRCK, ADCDAT, SDA, SCL connect to XIAO D0, D1, D2, D3, D4, D5. WM8960 and buffer run on the XIAO 3V3. LiPo battery through switch SW1 to the XIAO BAT+ and BAT- pads. Pins drawn in the XIAO's real order: D0 to D6 on one side; 5V, GND, 3V3, D10 to D7 on the other; battery pads underneath. Labels with the same name (3V3, Vref, CE) are connected.
svg.text: WM8960 is the I2S clock master. XIAO D0 gives it a 16 MHz MCK. Status: RGB LED on the XIAO.
